[[Sambasiva Rao]] (President) | industry = [[Dairy]] and [[agribusiness]] | products = | revenue = {{up}}{{INRConvert|3805|c}} (2024){{cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/financials/heritagefoods/consolidated-profit-lossVI/HFI#HFI|title=Heritage Foods Profit & Loss}} | net_income = {{up}}{{INRConvert|113|c}} (2024) | owner = [[Nara Chandrababu Naidu|Nara family]] | num_employees = 3000+ | footnotes = | founded = {{start date and age|1992|06|05|df=yes}} | hq_location = [[Hyderabad]], Telangana, India | website = {{URL|http://www.heritagefoods.in}} }} '''Heritage Foods Limited''' is an Indian [[private sector]] [[dairy]] enterprise, operating primarily in [[South India]]. It has its headquarters in [[Hyderabad]], India. == History == The Heritage Group was founded in 1992 by [[Telugu Desam Party]] chief and current [[Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh]], [[Nara Chandrababu Naidu]], with three-business divisions viz., dairy, retail and agri under Heritage Foods Limited (HFL), one infrastructure subsidiary – Heritage Infra Developers Limited and other associate companies viz., Heritage Finlease Limited, Heritage International Limited and Heritage Agro Marine Private Limited.{{cite news|url=http://www.livemint.com/2007/11/16003807/Heritage-Foods-plans-to-raise.html|title=Heritage Foods plans to raise Rs 100 crore|work=[[livemint.com]]|date=2007-11-16|agency=The Wall Street Journal}}{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/NEWS/Cities/Hyderabad/Naidu_family_gets_into_retail/articleshow/734016.cms|title=Naidu family gets into retail|author=K V Ramana|date=2006-12-07|work=[[The Times of India]]|publisher=Times Internet Limited}} In 1994, HFL went public with an [[initial public offering]], which was oversubscribed 54 times. Its shares are listed on BSE and NSE.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/heritage-foods-limited/heritgfood/519552/|title=Stock Share Price {{!}} Get Quote {{!}} BSE|website=bseindia.com|access-date=2020-01-04}} ==Products== Heritage's products include [[milk]], [[curd]], [[ice cream]], [[buttermilk]], [[flavored milk]], dairy whitener, skim milk powder, along with fruits, vegetables, bakery products and [[private label]] products like [[cereal]]s, [[pulse (legume)|pulses]], [[staple food|staples]], and [[spice]]s. ==References== {{reflist}} == Further reading == * {{cite news|title=INDIA: Heritage Foods given purchase approval|date=2006-04-24|work=just-food.com|url=https://www.just-food.com/article.aspx?id=94628&lk=sd02}}{{Dead link|date=December 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} * {{cite news|work=[[The Hindu]] Business Line|title=Heritage Foods Q3 net up 32 pc|date=2003-10-31|url=http://www.blonnet.com/2003/01/31/stories/2003013101830300.htm}} – plants commissioned by the company in 2003 * {{cite news|title=INDIA: Heritage Foods buys Maharashtra dairy|date=2007-09-10|work=just-food.com|url=http://www.just-food.com/article.aspx?id=99639|archive-date=15 September 2007|access-date=13 September 2007|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070915015645/http://www.just-food.com/article.aspx?id=99639|url-status=dead}} [[Category:Dairy products companies of India]] [[Category:Companies based in Hyderabad, India]] [[Category:Nandamuri–Nara family| ]] [[Category:Agriculture companies established in the 1990s]] [[Category:Companies established in 1992]] [[Category:Food and drink companies established in 1992]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1992]] [[Category:1992 establishments in Andhra Pradesh]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
